integrity: The result is proved analytically and accompanied by a standalone finite numerical checker. The checker does not prove the continuum theorem. No independent external validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive mean and the shape-one Delaporte/Poisson–geometric convolution only; endpoint quadratic coefficients are pointwise in the mean. General entropy/convex-order implications and the convolution law predate this work. Accessible prior full-text comparisons were incomplete for the original PoiG preprint and journal version. No independent historical-priority certification.
title: Sharp entropy-endpoint laws along the fixed-mean Poisson–geometric path
